APPROVE
`InScript` drops to two flat `if`s (complexity about 2), each extracted helper stays under 15, and the loops and conditions run in the same order, so behaviour is unchanged; I couldn't find the source file to compile, so the build is safe only if the new parameter types (`Func<Family, bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`) match what `GuardBindings`, `Known`, `InStyleSheet`, `ReadsGuard` and `ScriptGuarded` actually take and return.
